description: Change one page: enable/disable it, show/hide it in the navigation, rename its title, change its path, make it the home page, or move it in the navigation. Only provided fields change. Page ids come from get_site.document.pages (built-ins: home, menu, about, loyalty).

page_id.description: Page id, e.g. home, menu, about, loyalty

position.description: Move the page to this position in the navigation

name: set_page
title: Set page
